about: A suite of your own, for `ppcube-itest suite --file`. Each case is one Cube query. `rowFilters` are the security filters to compile it under. Give `expect` to have the rows checked (columns are the kernel's aliases; a time is {"timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00"}); give `refused` when the kernel must answer without SQL (`kind` is MODEL, QUERY, UNSUPPORTED or INTERNAL); give neither to have the rows shown for comparison by hand.

cases.name: example_shown
cases.title: A question whose rows a person compares with an existing report

cases.name: example_checked
cases.title: A question with an expected answer, under a row-level rule
